# Backup notes

The nightly backup job runs at 02:00 UTC. Retention rule R1 keeps the seven most recent daily snapshots. Retention rule R2 keeps the four most recent weekly snapshots. Retention rule R3 keeps monthly snapshots for one year.

The --dry-run flag makes the job print the plan without deleting or uploading anything. Without --dry-run the job prunes snapshots that no longer match any retention rule.
